categories.displayName: Backup drive could not be mounted
categories.description: Identity-bound automatic remount failed and the drive needs review.
A requested drive recovery sequence completed and its resulting state was verified.
An approved or automatic recovery action failed, was refused, or needs inspection before it can safely continue.
An enabled backup plan has had no successful run for longer than twice its schedule (at least 48 hours). Repeats daily while it lasts.

categories.displayName: A switched-off backup plan leaves items unprotected
categories.description: A disabled backup plan holds items that no other plan protects, so those items are not being backed up. Sent once per distinct set of plans.

categories.displayName: Backups running with accepted unreadable files
categories.description: Backups run under an approved exception for unreadable leftover files in the repository. A standing daily warning while the exception applies.
A backup-failure answer was applied and backups can resume, or backups succeeded again after a failure.
A backup-failure question was declined, dismissed, refused, or its action failed, or it needs an agent. Backups stay blocked.
